readmeOverlay.title: Stream Monsters 1.6 – Retention Core
readmeOverlay.summary: Stream Monsters 1.6 adds an optional recurring free egg alongside creator-selected gift eggs. A viewer receives the offer on chat contact, has a 60-second private reservation to hatch it, and then releases it to the public FIFO where another viewer may adopt it.
highlights: Creators can enable or disable the optional recurring free egg and configure its cooldown.
Unclaimed free eggs become publicly adoptable after the 60-second reservation without replacing gift mappings.
Gift eggs, incubation queues, hatching, collections, and permanent progress remain compatible.

readmeOverlay.title: Stream Monsters 1.7 – Competitive Arcade
readmeOverlay.summary: Stream Monsters 1.7 builds on the optional recurring free egg and its 60-second reservation followed by public adoption. The portrait-first arcade introduces sealed A/B/C battle choices and balanced Striker, Guardian, Trickster, and Sustain roles.
highlights: A/B/C choices stay sealed until both fighters have locked or timed out, then reveal together.
Striker, Guardian, Trickster, and Sustain create readable strengths and counterplay across the six elements.
Portrait arcade presentation, deterministic replays, gift eggs, and public free-egg adoption remain compatible.
